request.description: Ask the factory for a missing capability, as a functional contract: required_outputs (name, quantity, unit, horizonMinutes), constraints, observations, data files, topics ("graph", "onnx", or "auto", the default), budget (iterations 20, minutes 30, twinPoints 40 by default). Returns the task id. Describe the need, not a solution.

task.description: State of a task: created, running, proposed, accepted, rejected or failed; workspace; taskSha256; files; manifest (null until the loop writes one).
